page.layout: Running head at top; one page of text in a single column with a poem set in verse lines, and a second heading block with a verse opening at the bottom; right-hand page number "510" at top right and signature "G 2" at the foot; marginal ornaments/fragments at left and right edges are not text notes.

main_text.head: IOANNIS TAGAVTII, PARISIENSIS, Poetæ insignis, Mathematicarum disciplinarum doctiss. in Academia Laufanensi, ac deinceps Genevensi, Professoris: in ipso ætatis flore mortui, Memoriæ.
main_text.l: Ondere, mensura, numero, & vis Numinis illa
Inc abiit forsan cæli post concava, cæli
Ua quum mensura, numerorum, & ponderis omnis,
Silicet ille suam noscendi cuncta reperto
Corporis atque animi fruitur nunc pace, relictis
main_text.head: LARISS. VIRI, IOANNIS Simbuci, Pannonij, veterum florentissimorum plurimorum scriptorum aliorumque, Memoriæ.
main_text.p: Vm ciet obscuro Graias Latiasq; CamœnasOblivionis efpecu,

page.notes: Page is partly damaged on the left edge; several verse lines are only partly legible and the first letters of some lines are uncertain. The second heading block is partly cut off at the foot of the page; the line "veterum florentissimorum plurimorum scriptorum aliorumque" is a conjectural reading of a smudged line and should be checked against the scan.
